project.name: M3JDK :: File Port
project.description: The jdk.m3.file family (module org.m3jdk.file): M3File, M3ByteFile, MappedM3File, the file universe (events, snapshots, token index, traversal), M3FmtVarints / lexicon frames / frozen dictionary, M3JniLibraryLoader with M3NativeLibrarySpec, M3ProgressMonitor (an adapter over the owner jdk.m3.collections.M3ProgressMonitor, with the snapshot model), M3JsonStructuralIndex. Pure Java 21; com.m3:m3-collections is the only dependency outside java.base; the natives under native/ are built by their CMakeLists.txt and loaded at run time through M3JniLibraryLoader. This pom gives the lane a build and makes it a dependency owner for the other m3 modules (first consumer: the native search engine, which needs the library loader).
